kontakt.name: SV Par. BP/BP
kontakt.processing_contract: Two parallel band-pass branches; preserve independent branch tuning and resonance.

kontakt.name: SV Ser. LP/HP
kontakt.processing_contract: Serial low/high state-variable branches; preserve ordering and both histories.

kontakt.name: 3x2 Versatile
kontakt.processing_contract: Three two-pole sections with type, shifted cutoff, resonance and amount; the section graph and gains matter.

kontakt.name: Dual SKF
kontakt.processing_contract: Separate high/low Sallen-Key branches with resonance and FM; nonlinear branch states and routing matter.

kontakt.name: Simple LP/HP
kontakt.processing_contract: Selectable low/high filtering; preserve cutoff conversion and response selection.

kontakt.name: Formant I
kontakt.processing_contract: Resonant spectral/formant shaping with Talk, Sharp and Size; formant placement/interpolation remains unresolved.

kontakt.name: Formant II
kontakt.processing_contract: Second formant response with Talk, Sharp and Size; shared class evidence does not prove the same coefficients as Formant I.

kontakt.name: Phaser
kontakt.processing_contract: Phase/notch response with cutoff and resonance; stage topology and coefficient laws remain unresolved.

kontakt.name: Vowel A
kontakt.processing_contract: Vowel-like resonances controlled by cutoff and resonance; keep a separate coefficient/morph path from Vowel B.

kontakt.name: Vowel B
kontakt.processing_contract: Second vowel-filter response; resonant-band layout and cutoff mapping remain unresolved.

kontakt.name: Solid G-EQ
kontakt.processing_contract: High/low cuts, switchable shelf/bell bands and two parametric mid bands; preserve band topology and interactions.

kontakt.name: Compressor
kontakt.processing_contract: Envelope-dependent gain reduction; preserve detector mode and channel linking. The native signed-mean linked detector has been checked; the complete gain law has not.

kontakt.name: Feedback Compressor
kontakt.processing_contract: Feedback-controlled dynamics with parallel blend and an optional quality path; detector placement and nonlinear gain law need reconstruction.

kontakt.name: Limiter
kontakt.processing_contract: Peak containment with input gain and release memory; threshold, lookahead and recovery behaviour need native confirmation.

kontakt.name: Solid Bus Comp
kontakt.processing_contract: Bus dynamics with ratio, timing, makeup and parallel mixing; stereo coupling and the model-specific detector matter.

kontakt.name: Supercharger GT
kontakt.processing_contract: Dynamics combined with saturation, detector high-pass, character modes and stereo/dual-mono/MS linking; several processing stages must be preserved.

kontakt.name: Transient Master
kontakt.processing_contract: Attack/sustain envelope reshaping with a smooth mode; an implementation needs separate transient and sustain control rather than only a threshold/ratio curve.

kontakt.name: Transparent Limiter
kontakt.processing_contract: Ceiling-controlled dynamics with release; a named HilbertLimiter core exists, but that name alone does not establish its signal-processing equations.

kontakt.name: ACBox
kontakt.processing_contract: Amp model with two volume paths, tone controls and tremolo. Native ACBOX stage-specific waveshaping table classes exist; stage connections and curves remain unverified.

kontakt.name: Bass Invader
kontakt.processing_contract: Bass amp model with boost, contour, low cut, tone stages and master gain; preserve stage order and nonlinear drive.

kontakt.name: Bass Pro
kontakt.processing_contract: Bass amp model with switchable voicing, graphic EQ, drive and master gain; the graphic stage is a separate part of the contract.

kontakt.name: Cabinet
kontakt.processing_contract: Speaker/cabinet coloration with model, size and air controls; neither convolution nor a particular filter network is established by these controls.

kontakt.name: EP Preamps
kontakt.processing_contract: Electric-piano preamp coloration with drive/EQ modes and tremolo waveform/stereo controls; gain nonlinearity and modulation are separate stages.

kontakt.name: HotSolo
kontakt.processing_contract: Amp model with normal/overdrive paths, presence and depth; HOTSOLO per-stage waveshaping table classes provide identity evidence, not verified transfer curves.

kontakt.name: Jump
kontakt.processing_contract: Amp model with high-gain switching, preamp/master and presence; JUMP stage and power-tube table classes exist, with the complete circuit path unresolved.

kontakt.name: Reverb Delight
kontakt.processing_contract: Amp processing plus selectable reverb and tremolo with sag; preserve the interaction between amp drive, tremolo and reverb.

kontakt.name: Super Fast 100
kontakt.processing_contract: Amp model with normal/overdrive, bright/crunch, tone, presence and depth controls; switching affects a multi-stage processing contract.

kontakt.name: Twang
kontakt.processing_contract: Amp coloration with bright switching and voice-scope selection; per-voice and summed processing can give different nonlinear results.

kontakt.name: Van51
kontakt.processing_contract: Amp model with rhythm/lead and gain/voicing switches; VAN51 stage-specific and power-tube table classes exist, while exact stage routing is unresolved.

kontakt.name: Big Fuzz
kontakt.processing_contract: Fuzz nonlinearity plus sustain/tone/voicing; a BigFuzz table class is present, but no verified transfer curve is supplied.

kontakt.name: Cat
kontakt.processing_contract: Distortion with filter, voicing and tone stages; input level and ordering affect the generated harmonics.

kontakt.name: Chainsaw
kontakt.processing_contract: Distortion with independent low/high shaping and output level; its specialized clipping law remains unverified.

kontakt.name: Cry Wah
kontakt.processing_contract: Pedal-controlled moving resonance; preserve the pedal-to-frequency/Q law and nonlinear behaviour.

kontakt.name: Dirt
kontakt.processing_contract: Two distortion sections A/B with separate drive, mode and amount, plus bias, tilt and routing; the routing choice is part of the DSP state.

kontakt.name: Distortion
kontakt.processing_contract: Mode-selectable drive with damping; mode changes need a distinct shaping/filter path.

kontakt.name: DStortion
kontakt.processing_contract: Drive with tone and three EQ controls; clipping curve and EQ position remain unresolved.

kontakt.name: Fuzz
kontakt.processing_contract: Fuzz with amount and bass/bright voicing; a FuzzFace table class is present, without verified table values or signal-path placement.

kontakt.name: Kolor
kontakt.processing_contract: Mode-dependent nonlinear coloration, gain boost, bass preservation and HP/LP/mid shaping; preserve mode and the filter/drive order.

kontakt.name: Saturator
kontakt.processing_contract: Mode-dependent nonlinear shaping; Classic, Enhanced and Drums require separate transfer/state behaviour. The abbreviated native class association is a candidate.

kontakt.name: Skreamer
kontakt.processing_contract: Overdrive with tone/voicing and clean blend; nonlinear wet processing and clean summing are separate.

kontakt.name: Skreamer Deluxe
kontakt.processing_contract: Mode-dependent overdrive with tone and bass/mid/treble controls; its filter topology and drive law remain unresolved.

kontakt.name: Bite
kontakt.processing_contract: Quantization and rate reduction with jitter, pre/post filters, dither, saturation and DC handling; stochastic state and quantizer boundaries matter.

kontakt.name: Lo-Fi
kontakt.processing_contract: Bit/rate reduction plus colored noise; sample holding, quantization and noise generation are independent behaviours.

kontakt.name: Tape Saturator
kontakt.processing_contract: Tape-style nonlinear coloration with warmth, high-frequency rolloff and a quality switch; exact saturation/history/filter design remains unresolved.

kontakt.name: Wow/Flutter
kontakt.processing_contract: Time-varying pitch instability with separate scrape/wow/flutter, speed, age, stereo, gate and saturation controls; retain modulation history.

kontakt.name: Choral
kontakt.processing_contract: Multi-voice modulation with mode, scatter, stereo width, feedback and inversion; voice count and inter-voice phase need preservation.

kontakt.name: Flair
kontakt.processing_contract: Multiple tuned modulation voices with chord/scan, thru-zero, feedback and detune controls; pitch-related delay lengths distinguish it from a single flanger.

kontakt.name: Freak
kontakt.processing_contract: Carrier-based processing with radio, oscillator and sidechain modes; carrier generation, modulation type, filtering and feedback require distinct paths.

kontakt.name: Phasis
kontakt.processing_contract: Moving notch/phase structure with notch count, center/spread, feedback, modulation mixing and an extended range; keep phase state and polarity.

kontakt.name: Ring Modulator
kontakt.processing_contract: Audio/carrier multiplication with selectable LFO shape, FM, frequency and edge controls; oscillator phase and nesting matter.

kontakt.name: Rotator
kontakt.processing_contract: Rotating-speaker processing with acceleration/braking, distance and balance; speed-transition state affects the output.

kontakt.name: Vibrato/Chorus
kontakt.processing_contract: Pitch modulation with chorus blending, color and stereo width; retain modulation phase and the dry/wet relationship.

kontakt.name: Legacy Chorus
kontakt.processing_contract: Modulated short-delay processing with depth, speed and phase; interpolation, delay history and stereo phase remain unresolved.

kontakt.name: Legacy Flanger
kontakt.processing_contract: Modulated comb response with feedback, color and phase; interpolation and feedback history must be retained.

kontakt.name: Legacy Phaser
kontakt.processing_contract: Modulated phase/notch processing with stereo phase and feedback; stage count, coefficients and state remain unresolved.

kontakt.name: Beat Masher
kontakt.processing_contract: Captured audio reordering/repetition with length, gate, rotate, reverse and wrap; needs a tempo-aware audio buffer and playback state.

kontakt.name: Beat Slicer
kontakt.processing_contract: Buffer slicing/resequencing with style, pattern, gate and buzz; preserve capture boundaries, slice selection and transport timing.

kontakt.name: Gater
kontakt.processing_contract: Tempo-aware amplitude patterning with shape, stutter and noise; preserve timing, phase and generated-noise state.

kontakt.name: Reverse Grain
kontakt.processing_contract: Grain playback with forward/reverse/inversion, pitch and speed; grain boundaries, windows, buffer history and overlap are distinct requirements.

kontakt.name: Transpose Stretch
kontakt.processing_contract: Buffer/grain transformation with key, transposition and stretch; needs independent playback pitch, grain scheduling and buffer length.

kontakt.name: PsycheDelay
kontakt.processing_contract: Delay with reverse playback, pitch/detune, stereo offset and cross-feedback; the feedback signal can undergo pitch/time transformations.

kontakt.name: Replika Delay
kontakt.processing_contract: Mode-dependent delay with pattern, shuffle, modulation, stereo routing, filtering and ducking; preserve each mode and its internal state.

kontakt.name: Twin Delay
kontakt.processing_contract: Two delay paths with separate predelay/time/feedback/level and cross-feedback; the two-channel feedback graph matters.

kontakt.name: Legacy Delay
kontakt.processing_contract: Feedback delay with damping and panning; delay interpolation, tempo mapping and block history remain unresolved.

kontakt.name: Convolution
kontakt.processing_contract: Impulse-response filtering with IR envelope, early/late shaping, resampling, reversal and latency controls; partitioning and exact IR preparation remain unresolved.

kontakt.name: Plate Reverb
kontakt.processing_contract: Reverberant network with predelay, decay, low shelf, high damping and stereo control; delay lengths and diffusion topology remain unresolved.

kontakt.name: Raum
kontakt.processing_contract: Mode-dependent reverberation with predelay feedback, diffusion, modulation and freeze; freeze/history and mode switching are separate contracts.

kontakt.name: Reverb
kontakt.processing_contract: Mode-dependent space response with diffusion, modulation, frequency shaping and stereo controls; the GaloisReverb association is a candidate, without recovered network coefficients.

kontakt.name: Legacy Reverb
kontakt.processing_contract: Reverberation with size/color/damping/stereo controls; preserve a distinct legacy state and response.

kontakt.name: Stereo Modeller
kontakt.processing_contract: Stereo-image transformation with pseudo-stereo, spread and pan; channel mixing and any decorrelation history require confirmation.

kontakt.name: Stereo Tune
kontakt.processing_contract: Stereo pitch variation with spread, drift and split; retain the two pitch paths and drift state.

kontakt.name: Surround Panner
kontakt.processing_contract: Multichannel gain/routing from position, angle, distance, divergence, LFE and format; preserve speaker layout and automation.

kontakt.name: AET Filter
kontakt.processing_contract: Sample-derived spectral morphing with morph layers/maps and analysis data. Native BDyxMorphGroup/BDyxMorphMap names exist; their exact audio/filter connection is unresolved.

kontakt.name: Gainer
kontakt.processing_contract: Smoothed gain: output uses the current gain before a float32 one-pole target update. Channel processing shares the starting state; persistent state advances once per frame.

kontakt.name: Inverter
kontakt.processing_contract: Polarity inversion and left/right exchange; per-channel signs and routing must be distinguished.

kontakt.name: Send Levels
kontakt.processing_contract: Level controls for the existing instrument send effects; preserve send taps, dynamic destination identity and processing scope.

workstation.name: 3 Band Compressor
workstation.processing_contract: Split-band dynamics; three threshold/ratio/timing/makeup/mix states and two crossovers.

workstation.name: 3 Band Limiter
workstation.processing_contract: Split-band ceiling control; independent thresholds, margins, release and mixing with two crossovers.

workstation.name: 3 Band Shelf
workstation.processing_contract: Three spectral gain regions with independently positioned low/mid and mid/high boundaries.

workstation.name: Analog Chorus
workstation.processing_contract: Modulation voices controlled by speed, width, intensity and transient enhancement; model-specific interpolation and voicing remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Analog Crunch
workstation.processing_contract: Nonlinear overdrive/trash path with gain, mix and oversampling; retain its own curve rather than another fuzz model.

workstation.name: Analog Filter
workstation.processing_contract: Mode-selectable resonant filter with key tracking; mode and frequency/Q laws remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Analog Flanger
workstation.processing_contract: Speed/width/intensity modulation with transient enhancement; shares a traced constructor with AnalogChorus, without proven mode-selection semantics.

workstation.name: Analog Tape Delay

parameters.name: Delay
parameters.unit: millisecond (beat ratio when synced: 4 is 1/1, 0.25 is 1/16, ...)

workstation.processing_contract: Delay with trash, distortion mode, stereo spread and interpolation-time control; coloration belongs to the feedback/delay design.

workstation.name: Autopan

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.unit: Hz (beat ratio when synced: 4 is 1/1, 0.25 is 1/16, ...)

workstation.processing_contract: Mode-selectable periodic channel-gain movement with depth and speed; retain oscillator phase and stereo law.

workstation.name: Big Pi Tone
workstation.processing_contract: Tone/gain coloration stage; exact filter coefficients and topology remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Biquad Filter
workstation.processing_contract: Mode-selectable second-order filtering with frequency, Q and key tracking; coefficient laws are not yet verified.

workstation.name: Bloom

parameters.name: PreDelay
parameters.unit: millisecond (beat ratio when synced: 4 is 1/1, 0.25 is 1/16, ...)

workstation.processing_contract: Reverberant/diffuse response with rise, tap structure, decay bands, modulation and freeze; several stateful sections must be retained.

workstation.name: Brickwall Filter
workstation.processing_contract: Steep filtering with slope and soft bypass; latency, design and transition behaviour remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Comb Filter
workstation.processing_contract: Frequency/Q/mode comb response; delay-line tuning, sign and interpolation remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Compressor Expander
workstation.processing_contract: Compression plus gating/expansion with separate thresholds, ratios and timing; preserve both detector paths and makeup/mix.

workstation.name: Convolver
workstation.processing_contract: Impulse-response processor with dry/wet and power normalization; IR loading, partitioning and normalization law remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Crossover Filter
workstation.processing_contract: Band splitting from low/high boundaries; output routing, filter slopes and reconstruction phase remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Diffuse Delay

parameters.name: DelayTime
parameters.unit: second (beat ratio when synced: 4 is 1/1, 0.25 is 1/16, ...)

workstation.processing_contract: Delay with diffusion, crosstalk, damping, randomness and modulation; keep diffusion and random/modulation history.

workstation.name: Diffusion
workstation.processing_contract: Diffusion stage with amount, start and mix; exact scattering/all-pass structure remains unresolved.

workstation.name: Digital Eq
workstation.processing_contract: Sixteen individually typed/enabled bands, with channel selection, slopes, bandwidth and global tuning/gain transforms.

workstation.name: Digital Filter
workstation.processing_contract: Filtering with slope, spread, Q, gain and bandwidth; preserve these dimensions rather than only a cutoff knob.

workstation.name: Diode Clipper
workstation.processing_contract: Drive/tone clipping with high-pass and asymmetry; exact nonlinear transfer and filter placement remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Dispersor
workstation.processing_contract: Cascaded all-pass sections redistribute phase/time. Native stage recurrence and persistent history are now verified in 168 original-byte blocks.

workstation.name: Drive
workstation.processing_contract: Mode-dependent nonlinear drive with oversampling; mode/curve and resampling stages remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Dual Delay X

parameters.name: DelayTime
parameters.unit: second (beat ratio when synced: 4 is 1/1, 0.25 is 1/16, ...)

workstation.processing_contract: Two delay paths plus tape shaping, dispersion, diffusion, crushing, filters, rotation and ducking; preserve the enabled subgraph and ratios.

workstation.name: Effect Rack
workstation.processing_contract: Effect container/routing object; its empty scalar parameter list does not mean it is an audio identity operation.

workstation.name: Ensemble 505
workstation.processing_contract: Mode/tone multi-voice modulation with mix; voice layout and modulation tables remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Exciter
workstation.processing_contract: Mode-dependent harmonic generation with amount, input/output gain, mix and oversampling; spectrum and nonlinear curve remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Feedback Compressor
workstation.processing_contract: Dynamics with knee and dynamic-range controls; detector placement, timing and gain law remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Feedback Machine
workstation.processing_contract: Feedback-capable processing container with delay time and mix; nested processing and loop scheduling are separate contracts.

workstation.name: Flanger

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.unit: Hz (beat ratio when synced: 4 is 1/1, 0.25 is 1/16, ...)

workstation.processing_contract: Feedback comb modulation with explicit delay time, depth and speed; interpolation and modulation phase remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Formant Crusher
workstation.processing_contract: Formant/filter morphing plus fractional decimation. Native prefilter→decimator→mix chain is observed; only the isolated decimator is executed/verified.

workstation.name: Freq Shifter
workstation.processing_contract: Frequency-offset processing with mirror, channel spread, crossover and pre-high-pass options; preserve sideband/phase state. Exact quadrature coefficients remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Fuzz
workstation.processing_contract: Fuzz-specific overdrive/trash path with gain, mix and oversampling; its transfer curve remains unresolved.

workstation.name: Gain
workstation.processing_contract: Volume processing with control buffers and channel-layout dispatch; complete gain scheduling is not yet verified.

workstation.name: Gain Matrix
workstation.processing_contract: Twelve-by-twelve channel gain/routing controls; traced code computes into scratch before copying outputs back, preserving input data for mixing.

workstation.name: Gate
workstation.processing_contract: Threshold-based attenuation with attack/release and mix; hysteresis, detector and smoothing remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Granulizer
workstation.processing_contract: Pitch/detune, grain period/density/jitter, delay/spread, feedback and direction; the traced audio wrapper delegates to per-channel grain state of stride 0xa80.

workstation.name: Guitar Boxes
workstation.processing_contract: Cabinet/microphone coloration with model, microphone type, separation/spread and mix; exact model filters/IRs remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Harmonic Resonators
workstation.processing_contract: Six individually tuned/gained/coupled resonator bands, decay/tone and note tracking; traced processing has per-channel state stride 0x3c0.

workstation.name: Harmonizer
workstation.processing_contract: Five independently enabled/detuned/gained voices with grain size; preserve voice buffers and windowing.

workstation.name: IReverb
workstation.processing_contract: IR-based space processing with time, low/high damping, predelay, width and normalization; saved SamplePath is additional resource evidence.

workstation.name: Ladder
workstation.processing_contract: Ladder-filter controls include voltage reference, resonance trim, gain compensation, algorithm and oversampling type; nonlinear topology remains unresolved.

workstation.name: LowPass 12
workstation.processing_contract: Resonant low-pass with frequency/Q/key tracking; exact coefficient and modulation laws remain unresolved.

workstation.name: LowPass 24
workstation.processing_contract: Resonant low-pass family with frequency/Q/key tracking; keep it distinct from MoogLadder and its extra model controls.

workstation.name: Magnetic Bass Shaper
workstation.processing_contract: Bass coloration with high-pass, drive, model and inductor controls; physical-model equations remain unresolved.

workstation.name: Maximizer
workstation.processing_contract: Level/ceiling processor with lookahead, knee, release blend and slew-rate control; latency and gain trajectory remain unresolved.

workstation.name: One Pole

workstation.name: Overdrive
